notes.text: When starting a new game, when asked to simulate a witcher 2 save, select 'On' so that you can choose what happened in the previous game during an interaction in Vizima.
In the main menu options, you can have alternate appearances for Yennefer, Triss, Ciri, Dandelion, and Nilfgaardian soldiers' armor.
Here is a list of many of the Easter Eggs that can be found in the game.
Here is a list of many of the Easter Eggs that can be found in the game.

When fast traveling, there are cut-scenes/loading screens that tell you what part of the main quest you are at. The narrator of these is actually an older Dandelion (a bard you will meet later on in the game). He is also the one that does all the journal entries for everything in your quest log.
There are new hair and beard options from the next gen update and from the latest  remaster.
With the next gen upgrade, you no longer need stamina to run outside of combat.
In the next gen upgrade, guards are no longer extremely over-leveled and can easily be dispatched if you anger them.
Fall damage has now been reduced.

Enable gameplay > enemy upscaling, so you cannot get too OP. With the latest remaster also enable gameplay > enable loot merge. if you are looking for more challenging gwent set gameplay > gwent difficulty level to hard.
Get the Temerian armor set at the Woesong Bridge vendor in White Orchard. Note that the set does not level with you, but if you wait until you are a higher level, the set will also be a higher level.
There is now a new animation for picking up herbs.
You can parry and break enemies' spears in combat, but it has to be the right kind of spear to do this. Halberds and poleaxes cannot be parried or broken, only simple spears.
You can now walk backwards while on horseback, do a flourish when going from idle to a gallop, and achieve a unique sort of backflip dismount animation when getting off Roach in tight spaces.
You can pet Roach now by holding down the jump button when your right hand is towards the head.
Roach can now kick enemies. She can even knock down werewolves so that you can do a finisher move on them. There is no other way to knock down a werewolf.
Roach can now run over enemies and either stagger or kill them. The dismount animations are now triggered based on where the camera angle is positioned.
Find Yen's raven skull at the beginning area (give it back to Yen eventually), see the battle from the intro, horse head, items from guy that Yen crashed into, etc.
Elsa the innkeeper and the merchant you saved from the griffin sell cards.

name: A Frying Pan, Spick and Span

notes.text: Break open the door to the house before talking to the frying pan lady to get unique dialogue.
Thaler's monocle dialogue is now fixed in the next gen update. Make sure to pick up the monocle in 'A Frying Pan, Spick and Span', so you can return it to Thaler in 'A Deadly Plot'.
During 'Missing in Action' you can see that Dune is missing a couple fingers.
Visit Tomira after Devil by the Well for more lore about the fate of the villagers. Tomira is the herbalist woman you will meet during 'The Beast of White Orchard' and 'On Death's Bed'.
This is started during The Beast of White Orchard when you speak with Tomira. Complete before the griffin.
Tomira in White Orchard will buy honey comb for 7 coins whereas other merchants will only buy it for 4 coins. If you aard a beehive all the way to Tomira's hut, it will actually kill her.
Lena's fate is determined in the Nilfgaardian camp later on in the game. I've put a reminder next to some quests that are closer to that area.
Hidden area of Nilgaardian camp. Open the door, climb the stairs, jump over the wall, and aard.
During 'The Beast of White Orchard', you can find an interesting sketch on the table of the Nilfgaardian captain. It appears to be a map of White Orchard.
You can find Florian's grave in the cemetary and it has a wooden sword. It doesn't state the truth of the love between him and Mislav.

If you remain in the fort after reporting the Griffin's death, you can hear the sound of whipping and the punished peasant crying in pain. The whiplashes will be struck 15 times as sentenced before the sound stops completely.
Spawn a chort by killing a bunch of cows.
Elsa the innkeeper might sell additional cards.
Best choices are: spared Aryan, sided with Vernon, saved Triss, saved Sile, spared Letho.
In Vizima, the chamberlain will give a different reaction to each of the 3 black outfits. He doesn't seem to like the one with the tight belt.
In Vizima, you can keep your towel for the rest of the game by dropping it and then picking it up after you pick your black outfit.
Speak with Morvran Voorhis and his friend about neutrality during 'Imperial Audience' (follow the chamberlain).
New gears from remasters are found in a chest in Yennifer's room in Vizima.
Enter a secret chamber by pressing a stone.
Play Gwent against the player in the courtyard in Vizima (Collect 'em All).
You can find the man that teaches you how to play gwent hanging from the Hanged Man's Tree near Mulbrydale. You can loot an unfinished book under him.
If you do 'Funeral Pyres' before 'In the Eternal Fire's Shadow', you will get some unique dialogue.
During the quest 'Funeral Pyres', when meeting the Eternal Fire Priest, you can see a map of the Witcher world lying on the stone table next to the priest.
Titus can die so make sure to jump in quickly to keep him alive if you wish to learn more and get more of a reward.
After burning the bodies, when you visit the priest, avoid triggering the start of Bitter harvest.

name: At the Mercy of Strangers Part 1

notes.text: If you save John Verdun, there will be a second part to this quest. You can find him again north of Ursten (you can check the map in the attached quest page link). Make sure to do part one when you pass by while completing 'The Nilfgaardian Connection'.
If you save John Verden, during 'At the Mercy of Strangers', in the second spot that he appears, you can find a note from a refugee at the back of his camp.

During 'The Nilfgaardian Connection', if you don't go to the inn at the crossroads right away and find Henrik instead, you'll get a unique interaction when visiting the Baron's castle during the quest 'Bloody Baron'.

During the 'Nilfgaardian Connection', as you make your way to the inn at the crossroads, there is a man that sends his daughter away in case the Baron's men return. You can even follow her and see her cowering in the woods or get attacked, though she can't actually die. If you don't kill the Baron's men in the inn, they will be asking the man about his daughter later on. There is also a couple that is concerned about their pigs and the man says he'd rather slaughter them then let the Baron's men have them.
During 'The Nilfgaardian Connection', even if you resolve the matter with the Baron's men peacefully, you can still get into a fight if you pester them long enough after the conversation.
If you fall from a great distance and die, you will sometimes hear a Wilhelm scream.
You can now find a candle lantern in a cave North West of the Hanged Man's Tree.
The Wild Hunt do not appear in the bestiary, so it can be useful to know that Elemental Oil works against them.
Buy every card in the inn.
Deadly crossing 2 is triggered by going across when Nilfgaardian soldiers are alive, then coming back at a later time.
On the other side of the bridge there's a blacksmith. If you have too much stuff in your inventory, you can sell things here.
Where to find the powerful sword called Moonblade. It is South West of Mulbrydale, in the water West of the bridge.
The traveling merchant switches between 3 main locations. Here is a map of where they are. He has dialogue at each place. First spot is west of Crow's Perch near Blackbough.
Second traveling merchant spot is east of Glory Gate.
Third traveling merchant spot is near Carston.
Complete immediately when encountered
In Hazardous Goods, if you help burn the cart, meditate far away from the area for 10-12 days and the man will reappear at a new location.
The person you save from 'Caravan Attack' will show up as a shopkeeper at Crow's Perch.

North West of the Inn of the Crossroads, you can pass through a Nilfgaardian camp and see a map of the Continent. The Redanians are on the opposite shore. On top of the hill, you can see a couple that have died and are holding hands.

In 'Face me if you Dare', Ronvid is fighting for Lady Bilberry. You can find a notice on a nearby noticeboard that says, 'My daughter Bilberry, a lovely girl and the apple of our eyes, died this year, the fourth of her short life. We buried her in the graveyard, by the crooked birch. Whoever wants to place a lump of earth or light a candle for her, that's where to go. — Butkins' This implies that Ronvid is Butkins and is fighting for his daughter that passed away.

Get the Nilfgaardian armor set from the quartermaster, which can be found in Crow's Perch along with matching horse gear. Note that the set does not level with you, but if you wait until you are a higher level, the set will also be a higher level.
You can get the Nilfgaardian crossbow from the quartermaster at Crow's Perch (part of the elite crossbow set)
Faster way to get up to the Smiths at Crow's Perch.
Find the underwater cave that leads to Crow's Perch.
You can see someone in Crow's Perch putting up the new signtravel post, which becomes available to use after the baron questline.
Secret room hiding a dead body in Crow's Perch.

name: Ciri's Story: The King of the Wolves

notes.text: In Ciri's Story: King of the Wolves, you can come back to this place as Geralt and fight a bear. It is South East of Lindenvale.
'Family Matters Part 1' is a long quest that goes up to the point of finding Anna and Tamara. The quests listed below will be interwoven within Part 1 of 'Family Matters', up until Part 2 begins.
Discover and check everything before talking to the baron.
During 'Family Matters', meet the stablehand afterwards if you saved him and he will reward you. This can be done after 'Ciri's Story: The Race' and the big event that occurs at Crow's Perch.

During 'Family Matters', you will see lines of salt in front of the houses when you are about to deal with the botchling. This detail takes place after you have spoken with the pellar during 'A Princess in Distress'.

Once you have completed 'A Princess in Distress' and have dealt with the botchling, after following the lumberkin, you can go to the Oxenfurt gate when trying to find Tamara, and you can trigger the 'Thou Shall Not Pass' quest. Once you get this quest started, return to the Baron to aquire the pass from him. Once you do this, then you can do 'Bitter Harvest' and 'Fake Papers', but it is suggested to do these two quests when you are a higher level since you will have to ensure someone is protected and kept alive in 'Bitter Harvest'.

Nibbles the cat appears in multiple locations. Unlike most cats, this one is not afraid of you. You can encounter her first when meeting Tamara in Oxenfurt. The link shows all the other possible locations you can find Nibbles.
You can get into Oxenfurt's highest tower using parkour This is the top of the Borsodi's Auction House and where your team goes to do the heist in Hearts of Stone.
Play Gwent with the Baron

name: The Mysterious Passenger

specialNote.text: The following quest is not worth doing considering how out of order you will have to do certain quests. It is simply a 3 minute bit of dialogue and that is it. If you would like to watch it, i've attached a youtube clip of the quest itself in the extra details link. I've only added it here in case someone did want to do it.

notes.text: The Mysterious Passenger is a very short quest that just involves dialogue on Uma, so doesn't really matter if you miss it. If you do the quests in the intended order this will not be started therefore it's not going to show a red mark in the quest tracker.

disablers: Ciri's Story: Out of the Shadows

notes.text: Once you complete 'Deadly Crossing (I), make sure to do 'Deadly Crossing (III)' within a few in game days, otherwise it may disappear.
Complete 'Deadly Crossing (III) within a few days of completing 'Deadly Crossing (I), otherwise it may disappear.

This detail is not part of this quest, but involves a possible bug from freeing a merchant that happens to be near the start of 'Highwayman's Cache'. Just south east of The Boatmaker's Hut, free the Claywich merchant who is held captive. Be careful because this merchant can be bugged. Make a save just before opening his cage, then fast travel to Claywich. If the talking option doesn't show up, reload until it does or meditate until daylight. Make sure to buy all the gwent cards he has for sale.

During 'A Princess in Distress', you can actually kill the bear ahead of time before you encounter it while leading the goat back to the pellar. If you do this, Geralt will have some extra dialogue while leading Princess back.
This is the fight you have with the Baron during the huge fire. It is part of the 'Family Matters' questline.

Once you have completed 'A Princess in Distress' and have dealt with the botchling, after following the lumberkin, you can go to the Oxenfurt gate when trying to find Tamara (but don't proceed to find Tamara yet because you can have a unique interaction with the Baron first), and you can trigger the 'Thou Shalt Not Pass' quest. Once you get this quest started, return to the Baron to aquire the pass from him. Once you do this, then you can do 'Bitter Harvest' and 'Fake Papers', but it is suggested to do these two quests when you are a higher level since you will have to ensure someone is protected and kept alive in 'Bitter Harvest'.
Complete immediately when triggered.
Secret chest found North East of Codger's Quarry.
Spare the man being hanged.
Save before visiting. It is really easy to miss the 'eavesdropping' part of the quest and get a red mark.

During 'Hunting a Witch', when you speak with the peasant man about Keira's whereabouts, there is another way to get the info. Cancel out of the convo, meditate outside of the area and wait for the man to start walking. Slowly follow until he is attacked by nekkers, then save him.
Follow Keira to the portal right away. It's possible to get a red mark, if you miss it.

During 'Wandering in the Dark', when you get the eye of Nehaleni, don't go further and don't use it yet because there is another hidden room at the opposite end of the big room. Use aard to break through a wall and then you'll see a hidden area.
Accept Keira's request at the end of this quest and complete 'Magic Lamp' right away.
Must be completed right after doing 'Wandering in the Dark'.

In 'A Towerful of Mice', you can get the better ending where Annabelle is laid to rest, without doing any investigations. If you speak to Annabelle and then say that you need to look around some more, then try and leave the tower, she will lock the door and attack you.

Mysterious female shadow that appears around Fyke Isle when you are sailing. It does not appear before or after the quest 'A Towerful of Mice', only during. There is also a weird transparent object floating near the boat that can react to igni and you'll hear a male and female scream. It seems the shadow and the transparent object appear when Keira is speaking to you with the Xenovox. The likely explanation is that the developers created an invisible npc that Keira can speak through.
In 'A Towerful of Mice', you can find a ghostly statue only sometimes and at certain camera angles and appears to be a statue of the virgin Melitele.
Towerful of Mice quest: The Mage experimented on local people as well as rats.
In 'Towerful of Mice', before the curse is lifted, all the flames (candles, torches, etc) can not be extinguished.
In 'Towerful of Mice', the mage Alexander, refers to Keira Metz in his note and calls her 'The Woman'.

During 'A Towerful of Mice', there are some details about Graham, the man that lost his love. Inside Graham's house, you can find a noose, implying he was going to kill himself soon. He has also built an altar for his love inside his hut.
In 'A Towerful of Mice', you can talk to a man outside Graham's hut to get more information about him.
'A Towerful of Mice' has 3 haunted spots outside of the tower and 5 inside (one of those 5 being related to the quest).
If you release the pesta in 'A Towerful of Mice', the red miasmal from the 'In the Eternal Fire's Shadow' quest will make a comment regarding this.

If you didn't go back to see the Pesta killing Graham during 'A Towerful of Mice', the dialogue between you and Keira is slightly altered. If you brought back the bones, the pesta will never disappear from the house and you can't kill it.
During 'A Favor for a Friend' you can find the corpse of the driver of the food cart (connected with 'Devil by the Well').

options.name: Keira was spared and sent to Kaer Morhen
Keira was spared and sent to Radovid

notes.text: For the best ending: spare Keira and send her to Kaer Morhen.

The best conversation path is to ask about the notes, "Radovid never forgets", "It's suicide", and then the fourth dialogue option will let you suggest Kaer Morhen. If you convince her to go to Kaer Morhen, you can then ask for the notes without having to kill her.

If you take the less ideal ending and send Keira to Radovid at the end of this quest, it will unlock a future quest that would not be available otherwise. This future quest is 'A Final Kindness', but is once again part of the bad ending for Keira. Choosing this path will also partially fail the future 'Brothers in Arms: Velen' quest.
'Defender of the Faith' can be started at one of two locations, but it is just one quest.

The 3 different types of statues that you can find around Velen can possibly represent the Goddess Melitele in her three forms: a young carefree girl (can be found near the Midcopse signpost or at the second intersection east of Blackbough), a mature pregnant woman (one can be found at the first intersection east of Blackbough), and a hunched old woman (one can be found north of The Orphans of Crookback Bog signpost, just to the east of the burnt/torn down hut). It is possible they can also represent the 3 crones. Based on the quest 'Defender of the Faith', the woman that gives you the quest tells you that the statue is of Verna the Merciful. You can also see the three statues on your way to talk to Thecla during 'Bald Mountain'.
Complete immediately, don't let the dog die, and follow it closely afterwards.

name: The Fall of the House of Reardon

notes.text: Find Dolores's diary and treasure.

Check out the basement with the breakable wall AFTER completing the quest because you can get additional dialogue with Dolores 2 days later. Visit Dolores at the manor two days after completing the quest to get some additional dialogue and then go in the basement and speak with her again once you've found the skeleton. She will then spend some time in the basement crying in front of the skeleton.
The skeleton in here might be Dolores's brother and he may have been in love with her.
Avoid all of Letho's traps to get unique dialogue with him once you meet.
Find a painting of Dolores and her brother in the house.
In 'Ghosts of the Past', choose "Don't want trouble" after meeting Vester, then "his medallions all you need" so you can send Letho to Kaer Morhen.
In 'Ghosts of the Past', you can kill Louis right away after Letho decides to leave him for dead.
During 'Ghosts of the Past', when given the choice between "you're as good as dead" and "don't want trouble" you can hear Letho snoring before selecting the option.
How to trigger the third looters marker and where to find the other two
There's a 3rd option to complete 'The Whispering Hillock', but you have to find the tree before starting 'Ladies of the Wood'. You can release the spirit this way and still get the good Baron ending.

The following doesn't have anything to do with this quest: before freeing Dandelion in the main game, visit the starting point of Blood and Wine to find and loot the drawings of the beast there (Stonecutters' Settlement).
In 'The Whispering Hillock', just east of the place of power, behind a rock, you can find the body of a kid.
If you have trouble with the werewolf, use the moon dust bomb to prevent his healing abilities.
If you did not release the tree spirit, after first talking to the Crones, go back to Downwarren and get some extra dialogue with the man that cut off his ear.

In 'Ciri's Story: Fleeing the Bog', Ciri hides in a tree to escape Imlerith. This may be referencing a part of the Witcher book, Sword of Destiny, in which Geralt tells Ciri a story about how a tomcat that gets lost in a forest, and is chased by a fox and hunters, ends up escaping by climbing a tree.
Part 2 starts once you've found Tamara and Anna.

A very small quest ('A Mysterious Passenger'), which is just dialogue, will be missed if you continue. You need to do most of the Skellige story first in order to get it, so it is not worth it to do 'A Mysterious Passenger'.

name: Ciri's Story: Out of the Shadows

notes.text: You can find the place where Ciri fought the Basilisk in 'Ciri's Story: Out of the Shadows' at the forgotten tower west of Heatherton.

In the basement, underneath the crone tapestry, you can find unique voodoo dolls that represent people that the crones have cursed, including Anna, a peasant from Downwarren, and Vivienne from the DLC Blood and Wine quest 'The Warble of a Smitten Knight'.
Check the linked map for exact location.
Check the linked map for exact location.
First talk to the guy from Fake papers, but do not pay or use axii.
Must be completed when started. Save game before because if Alvin dies, 'Fake Papers' will fail.

name: At the Mercy of Strangers Part 2

notes.text: Do the second part of the encounter.
For this quest to become available, you need to clear both the boatyard abandoned site (between Refugees' Camp and Condyle) and the pirate base on the peninsula west of it of all pirates.
In 'Love's Cruel Snares', if you refuse to help the woman, she will venture out herself and ends up getting killed by the wild dogs.

In 'Love's Cruel Snares', once the quest is completed, and you wait a few days, if you go to the spot where the man died, you will find the woman and it looks like she is eating the body. This happens to be in an area of Velen where there are many cannibals.

After the Merry Widow contract is complete, wait a day or 2 and head back to the area you fought the grave hag. You will see 2 statues that change places when you enter and exit the crypt. Their faces change as well the further away you move from them. This is a reference to a Doctor Who episode.
To begin this quest, complete 'The Merry Widow' and then wait at least 5 in game days for 'Witcher Wannabe' to appear.

After Witcher Wannabe, if you lie and DON'T expose him as a wannabe witcher, you can get him to work off his failure with the village elder. You can find the wannabe witcher working in a small field at the southern entrance (southeast of the signpost) a day or so later. He is still wearing the witcher medallion.

name: The Truth is in the Stars

notes.text: During 'The Truth is in the Stars', you can find a 'man killing' rabbit.

There is a man that you can find in Velen, just north-east of Lurtch. Normally, he will immediately attack you, but if you can get close to his hut while he is still inside, you can see him eating a dead body. He seems to have killed a man, his wife, and their dog, while leaving the fish on the stove untouched and instead, consuming the bodies.
During Fool's Gold, follow Yontek and you will see him do some magic spells.
For the quest Fool's Gold, return to the village after the quest is complete to get some rare dialogue about the caretaker from Hearts of Stone.
During 'Fool's Gold', you can find a symbol in the pig's temple that looks like the symbol the crones placed on Anna's hand. This might imply that the crones were involved in the pig curse.

During 'Fool's Gold', Igor the pig can actually eat the horn of plenty that can potentially be given to you by Gaunter O'Dimm if you side with him and choose that specific reward during Hearts of Stone.
In 'Wild at Heart', if you spare Margrit and kill Niellen, you can receive a key to unlock the chest in the cabin upstairs. You can also find Margrit in the cabin crying.
The Eye of Nehaleni is needed to complete this quest.

During 'A Greedy God' dispel the ruins around the back and speak to the Allgod before speaking with the peasants in order to get additional dialogue. If you spared him, come back to the area 2 days later to find the peasants praying and the Allgod grumbling. If you killed him, follow the peasants back to their homes and you will see them praying to another god.

To trigger Last Rites quest, repair the shrines around Velen (Defender of the Faith quest) and appear at night. Do not meditate in close proximity. Next to the grave, use Keira's lamp to get a unique scene.
Lena's fate (from the Swallow potion - 'On Death's Bed') is determined in the Nilfgaardian camp.
In The Volunteer, Trollolo's painting is actually much better than Geralt's.
If you decide to let the Scoia'tael be, but inform the captain about them, you can later be ambushed by Vernossiel, the leader of the Scoia'tael group, close to the Glory Gate signpost.
You can investigate further to find a cave with bodies and get a better dialog outcome.
There is a Nilfgaardian area called The House of Respite that you can only enter while wearing Nilfgaardian attire (can be the formal clothes). In this area, there is a section that you can't enter.

In the House of Respite area in the Nilfgaardian camp, once you get in using Nilfgaardian armor, you can loot a chest with more Nilfgaardian armor, as well as a helmet that is next to the chest. This helmet can be put on as a mask in the inventory menu, and it appears as a helmet with the Nilfgaardian wings in-game. If you turn on the alternative nilfgaardian armor in the main menu option settings, your Geralt will be wearing the Season 1 Netflix Nilfgaardian Armor set.

In 'Contract: Shrieker', you can talk to the boy, Symko, one final time to grant him some solace after you complete the quest. If you kill the goats nearby, the boy will temporarily be uninteractable and won't speak with you until you go away and come back.
If you are not over leveled, be prepared for one of the most challenging fight in the game.

During the Contract Swamp Thing, you will meet Leslav. He seems to have read a notice about peat and its different properties. You can find this notice in the village of Lindenvale in Crookback Bog before speaking with him. After completing the quest, you can find another notice that is looking for peat diggers now that the Bog is clear.

name: Out of the Frying Pan, Into the Fire

notes.text: You can find a man playing the flute in a boat near the docks south of Byways.

name: The Things Men Do For Coin...

notes.text: After clearing the abandoned village in the Mire Landing (Cestersover), you can run into a stuttering character from the Witcher 1 (South of Byways).
South of Byways, you can hear some interesting ambient dialogue that is likely referring to the botchling.
Interesting dead tree south west of Fyke Isle. It has many buried metal faces surrounding it, along with a chest that cannot be accessed.
The peasant you save will tell you where Witcher George's Griffin diagrams are.
In the Abandoned Tower, West of Heatherton, you can find two chests that are somewhat hidden.
You can speak to Fishgulper in front of Lindenvale's inn after the fight in Fists of Fury: Velen and give him some money for his family.
Visit crematorium (north of Oxenfurt Gate) at night to have it feel creepier. Listen to more dialogue during the day and meet an apothecary that was in the Witcher 2.
Complete immediately when encountered.
Don't let Ginter die.
Find Odrin at Novigrad's docks @6:06 (Merchant beside him sells 250 empty bottles).
Complete immediately when encountered.
Brief interaction between a role playing couple outside the Novigrad docks @4:01 (this is time sensitive and will fail once you've passed by the area).
If Karmic Justice isn't triggering, meditate until it's between 10pm and 1am. It may only occur at these times.
Meditate until it's between 6pm and 8pm.
Find the drunk barber in Novigrad @15:30 (He will give you the wrong haircut the first time around).
Play Olivier in Novigrad begore doing Now or Never.
In the quest log you may find a temporary failed task, because you can either follow a thief or ask the beggars. This failed task will disappear once the quest is done.

Here are 4 locations in Novigrad that have hidden loot. Just West of the Southern Gate in Novigrad, you can find and loot two hidden chests. North West of Electors' Square, you can find a chest near the rock wall. There is a shipwreck West of Hierarch Square where you can find 2 chests and a body to loot. On a small island West of Electors' Square, you can loot a chest.

Armorer in Hierarch Square in Novigrad that says top notch swords now actually sells a few good swords, two of which are actually in promos and trailers for the game. He'll stop saying "top notch swords" once you buy them.
Find Triss's Witcher 2 outfit in her home as well as writings/paintings outside of Triss's house.
In Pyres of Novigrad, don't approach too quickly, otherwise you'll miss Menge's speech.
In Pyres of Novigrad, if you pull out your sword while fighting the looters, they will instantly cower. When you go in the house, you will find the Rose of Remembrance, which is from the Witcher 2.
In Pyres of Novigrad, you can find scriptures/writings in certain spots outside of the house the looters are at.

In Pyres of Novigrad, there are 4 beggars you can speak with (the addled one is the only one that knows), or you can follow the thieves and get some interesting dialogue (they can lead you into a trap if they know you're following). Follow the thieves to get the location and then you can go back to the beggars to get the password.
In Pyres of Novigrad, you can enter the Putrid Grove through the sewers which gets a key that may not be available after this quest.
In Pyres of Novigrad, when in the Putrid Grove, there is some interesting ambient dialogue that you can find and a good saddle bag.

It is possible for Geralt to carry around a copy of the Kama Sutra with him if he has the right saddle (Zerrikanian saddlebags). You can also find this book on one of the people you save from the witch hunters on the outskirts of Novigrad and on a mage named Carduin. You can buy the Zerrikanian saddlebags from the merchant in the Putrid Grove.
In Pyres of Novigrad, when doing the rat catching with Triss, the merchant will pay the full amount upfront since he believes he will get it back off your corpse.
Buy jade figurine and lizard figurine from merchant in Gildorf right AFTER meeting Triss for the first time. The lizard figurine can start the 'Of Dairy and Darkness' quest.
You can get the Elven crossbow from a merchant on the Gildorf market square in Novigrad near St. Gregory's Bridge (part of the elite crossbow set).

Before starting 'Carnal Sins', you can meet the dwarf that ends up dead. Try to find him during 'Pyres of Novigrad', since the area will be blocked off during 'Carnal Sins' and possibly many quests before it. Also, in this area, you can find an interesting statue and patients that talk about the murder before it happens. They will also talk about the murder at the beginning of the 'Carnal Sins' quest.

Witch Hunter Raids, find a unique encounter near Glory Gate @0:45. A bunch of witch hunters knocking on a door (available after the rat catching part of the Pyres of Novigrad quest with Triss, but unavailable after you help the mages out of Novigrad).

Crazy cat lady outside of Novigrad has a diary that can start the hunt for the feline armor. You can follow her around and she'll say odd things. She also says she can't sleep and can be found outside at night. If you wait until around 10pm, leave the area slightly and come back, you will find a lot of dead rats near all of the cats.
The schedule of Ciri's performer friends are quite elaborate. Valdo is the first to get up and sits by the bank. The group set up the stage throughout the day before the performance at night.
Romantic bench outside of Novigrad @2:00 (meditate to see multiple couples come by).
This quest is proximity sensitive and will fail if you leave the area.

name: Hidden Messages of the Nilfgaardian Kind

notes.text: If you want the secondary quest 'Haunted House', then you must let Sarah stay in the house.

If you smoke Sarah out of the house, you will run into her again much later on with Johnny, but you won't be able to access the 'Haunted House' quest. The better option is to let her stay. In case you wanted to watch the video of her with Johnny later on in the game, check the video link. There are spoilers in the video.
You can find the notice a few days later on the notice board in Hierarch Square.

options.name: Won both fights against Rosa and accepted the lessons

notes.text: Speak to Zoltan about the different women once you have read Dandelion's planner, but before talking to any of the women. There is extra dialogue when doing this.
When meeting with Vespula during 'Broken Flowers', if you run away once the bandits start attacking, when you return, Vespula will be bloodied up and will have a unique scene.
During 'Broken Flowers', when picking a horse, choose the gray mare (Cantarella), and you will get a reference to Cahir (if Aryan is alive for this playthrough).
During 'Broken Flowers', if you make your own way to the Vegelbuds' residence for the horse race, you can overhear La Valette and Voorhis talking (if Aryan is alive).

When trying to find Molly during 'Broken Flowers', the Baroness La Valette will have a different reaction to you depending on if you killed her son Aryan in the Witcher 2 game. She will either be extremely pleasant or she will be rude to you and will not join you for the races. Morvran Voorhis will also have more to say about Aryan's demise and what happened since then if you killed Aryan. Molly becomes a noble lady if Aryan is dead instead of being a servant otherwise.
During 'Broken Flowers', as you approach the Nilfgaardian Embassy, before speaking with Rosa var Attre, you can see a message written on one of the walls.

In 'Broken Flowers', you can tell the guard that you are the new cook. You can go up to the door and get additional dialogue about asking for Rosa. If you say you are the swordplay instructor, he'll just let you in, but the other two pieces of dialogue are better since you'll have to go around the back to get inside. Saying you are the cook makes the soldier not want to let you in, but after you find an alternate way in, he will make a comment saying how Geralt said he was the new cook and that Geralt is lying. Rosa defends you and plays along.
During 'Broken Flowers', before speaking with Rosa var Attre, find a dead body behind the house.
During 'Broken Flowers', when meeting with Marabella, say that you can't wait, and you'll get a funny exchange with the kids.
If you released the mother of the crones during 'The Whispering Hillock', you can find a list of the children's names from Crookback Bog in Marabella's hut during 'Broken Flowers'.

After the Vegelbud race during 'Broken Flowers', once you speak to Molly, you will have the option of returning to Novigrad on your own, or joining La Valette and Morvran Voorhis. Choose to join them because when you return, Morvran will sit on a bench and you can speak to him to get some unique dialogue.
The ending with each of the women in 'Broken Flowers' will change slightly depending on the order that you see each of them.

Make sure to challenge Zoltan to gwent right at the end of 'Broken Flowers'. You can play him again later, but it's during a quest later on, so might as well get his card now and start 'Gwent: Old Pals'.
During 'Fencing Lessons', if you let her win the sword match, she will have some unique dialogue and will call herself the Black Bruxa.
The seven cats inn actually has seven cats.

paths.name: Fencing
paths.option: Won both fights against Rosa and accepted the lessons

notes.text: 'The Dwarven Document Dilemma' may not be able to be triggered if you have started 'Fencing Lessons' but have not yet completed it.
You should create a save before starting if you wish to make all checkmarks green.

Here is a video detailing the Gangs of Novigrad and Get Junior quests and how to achieve all green checkmarks for the objectives. Do this after the bathhouse scene with Reuven/Dijkstra. It's suggested to not bring up Dandelion during the bathhouse scene so you can focus on these quests first. During the video, there's a part when you speak with Ivor. Consider doing a save here and trying out the fight in the pit just to see the scenes that play out, but then reload your save before, since you don't want to actually go in the pits, and continue with what the video describes.
In order to not fail any of the parts of 'Get Junior' and 'The Gangs of Novigrad', follow this reddit post guide.
There is a special way to make this NOT fail after Get Junior (note added to that quest), otherwise this will fail once you meet Roche's contact during a later part of 'Get Junior'.

How to get Ciri's sword in the next gen edition during 'Ciri's Story: Visiting Junior'. Once you get to your stash, make sure to 'drop' your sword. Afterwards, you can go to the brothel to get a funny interaction. Follow the video to know how to finish the quest once you drop the sword in your stash. When you are Geralt, you can loot the sword that is dropped near the stash. This may have been fixed, so you might not be able to drop the sword anymore, but you can still do the brothel interaction. With the most recent update (4.01), you unfortunately can't do any of these unique situations, but you can still view the video to see how it used to happen.
In Oxenfurt, talk to Carduin next to Radovid's ship if Triss was saved in the Witcher 2.
If you saved Rico during 'Get Junior', then Geralt will mention him to the family during 'Apiarian Phantom'.
In Honeyfill Meadworks, you can find many halfling sized items in and around the house.
One of the halflings in the northern end of Honeyfill Meadows will say "Don't dare call me Bagginson" which references Bilbo and Frodo Baggins from the Lord of the Rings.
In 'Strangers in the Night', the merchant may in fact be a Nilfgaardian spy because the soldier finds Nilfgaard currency on the merchant's body afterwards.
Complete immediately when started.
You need to ask about the treasure, otherwise you will get a red mark in 'A Poet Under Pressure'

In 'Count Reuven's Treasure', if you ask about the treasure first, without angering the guards or giving up the charade with Triss, you will find the key to Reuven's treasure which makes Dijkstra happy. You won't get info on Dandelion, but you'll be able to get that later anyways.
During 'Count Reuven's Treasure', you can help Triss burn the place down with igni.

During 'The Play's the Thing', when you are recruiting jugglers from the performing troupe called the Puffins, they ask you to get rid of some thugs outside. What you can actually do is get rid of the thugs before even talking with the Puffins and you will get a different scene. This optional objective is also the only time Geralt will say 'Shit happens'. You will also get some funny dialogue if you try and bribe the thugs and then refuse to fight, but this only occurs if you see the puffins first and then see the gang.
In 'A Poet Under Pressure', when you talk with Dijkstra, he will give you either 3, 4, or 6 men depending on the different dialogue choices and only if you helped him get his treasure.
Loot more items while following the trail (Dandelion's perfume, wrong path, Dandelion's ring, his writings).

In 'A Poet Under Pressure', both the painting and ring can be given to Dandelion or kept for yourself. Additionally, they can be stored in your stash, and still be given to Dandelion, creating duplicates of them.

After receiving the portrait of Hierarch Hemmelfart, you can give it to Dandelion and he will eventually have it up on a wall (above the door that is straight ahead as you walk in to the Rosemary and Thyme @11:20).
Take the Gwent cards during 'A Dangerous Game' because after this, they can only be found from the Prison Warden in the quest 'The Great Escape'.
When chasing Duke, you can do the quest 'A Tome Entombed' while in the sewers. It's easy to miss, but not missable since you can go back in the sewers at another time.
In 'A Dangerous Game', when Geralt says "Zed's dead", it is a reference to the movie Pulp Fiction.
Collect the Green Statuette at Caesar's.
You can find this during 'A Dangerous Game' when you are chasing after Duke. As long as you have access to the sewers, you can access this quest later on as well.
During Cabaret, after recruiting Polly and before finishing the quest with the placards, speak with Dandelion and you will have some unique dialogue.
You can find Polly teaching the girls how to dance after hiring her in the 'Cabaret' quest.
Buy from a merchant at Gildorf.
Ideally complete before 'Now or Never', but it can still be done up until 'Final Preparations'.
Found during the 'A Dangerous Game' quest.
Ideally complete before 'Now or Never', but it can still be done up until 'Final Preparations'.

name: Races: The Great Erasmus Vegelbud Memorial Derby

notes.text: This race can only be found after or during most of 'Get Junior'. The start of the quest is found in Novigrad, but the race itself takes place in Velen near the Vegelbud residence. BEFORE starting the race, meet with Triss just to get some unique dialogue about Ingrid Vegelbud (don't start 'A Matter of Life and Death' yet) and THEN you can go do the 'Races: The Great Erasmus Vegelbud Memorial Derby'.

name: A Matter of Life and Death

notes.text: If you complete 'Redania's Most Wanted' first, you can get dialogue about the crystal from Triss, BUT if you want to have all green objectives complete, then you should NOT speak to Triss about the crystal, and should only speak to Yen about it. For some reason, even if you don't speak to Triss about it, it will still be marked as successful in the quest objectives.

In 'A Matter of Life and Death', when you meet Triss at her home, you will notice that the building is slanted. The house next to it is also crooked. There is an actual reason for this and you can hear it from the repair workers working on fixing the houses. Whoever was living next to Triss's house, tried to dig a tunnel all the way to Vivaldi's bank. The tunnel caved in and the houses sunk as a result.
You can get new dialogue with Triss about Ingrid Vegelbud if you have not yet met Lady Vegelbud.

As you are looking for the guy in the blue tunic during 'A Matter of Life and Death', you can find Triss in an alleyway. Once you find the guy, don't accept quite yet. You can return to Triss in the Alley to get a bit of extra dialogue.
There are 2 other guys with blue tunics that you can talk to during 'A Matter of Life and Death'.
Some dialogue with Triss that you may have missed while conversing with her during the Masquerade quest.
During the Masquerade quest, there is a reference to the movie 'Pretty Woman' at the beginning of the quest when a man refers to Triss as Vivian and mentions another man named Edward.

Find 3 unique people at the Masquerade @7:20 (Dijkstra, La Valette, and some dancing women with some men behind some bushes, etc.). Make sure to get the Dandelion Gwent card during this quest, otherwise you will not get a chance to get it later on.
In 'A Matter of Life and Death', you can run into a random drunk, Moritz, and Morvran Voorhis as well.
Check the linked map for the exact location.

prerequisites.name: A Matter of Life and Death

notes.text: Near the large temple of the eternal fire, in northern Novigrad, you will hear the bells ringing every day at noon. You can also hear the bells from the central square.

prerequisites.name: A Matter of Life and Death
A Matter of Life and Death

notes.text: If you found the dwarf during 'Pyres of Novigrad', this is the quest that you will find his dead body.

There is a unique scene at the gate of the morgue in Novigrad after the serial killer attacks Priscilla. When you are with Von Gratz during 'Carnal Sins', tell him you are not ready to go just yet after Priscilla is attacked. Then head to the gate and interact with the guard to get a cutscene.
In the 'Carnal Sins' quest, inspect corpse genitals twice for a unique line.
Crippled Kate's has no female clients and only 1 male worker.
During Carnal Sins, you can take Reverend Nathaniel's poker, but make sure to choose the correct dialogue to get correct information first. It keeps its heated glow when using it.
Make sure you have completed Keira's quest, 'Magic Lamp', so that you have the lamp that can reveal ghosts in this quest.

'In the Eternal Fire's Shadow', you can deal with the bandits in the Devil's Pit before speaking with the deacon, and Geralt will respond with some unique dialogue saying that they were already dealt with.
In the Eternal Fire's Shadow has multiple endings and you can see them in this video.
In the Eternal Fire's Shadow, if you die during combat, you'll get a unique death scene.
During 'In the Eternal Fire's Shadow', there are a couple references to 'Funeral Pyres' if you had completed it beforehand.
The spectre in 'In the Eternal Fire's Shadow' will mention the pesta from 'A Towerful of Mice' if you brought the bones to Graham.
If you get one of the good endings for 'In the Eternal Fire's Shadow', you will see a dog in Devil's Pit named Kal. This is likely a reference to Henry Cavill's dog who is also named Kal.

'In the Eternal Fire's Shadow', if you refuse to bring down the deacon and refuse to tell the deacon the specifics of what happened, the deacon will be grateful and will ask for your name. Geralt responds by saying 'Reinald' and the deacon then names the hospital he creates using Reinald's name, even though he thinks he's using Geralt's name.

'In the Eternal Fire's Shadow', there is a closed off building near the top of Devil's Pit. If you get the good ending where the area becomes populated with people, this building will become open with a merchant inside.
When Triss leaves her Novigrad residence during the 'Now or Never' quest, her landlords can be seen rummaging through her things (before you join up with Triss).
During 'Now or Never' when saving Berthold and Annise, you can speak with their landlords on the main floor before you leave the house. You can punch the man.
If you saved Moritz after 'A Matter of Life and Death', you can find him with the other mages during 'Now or Never'.
During the quest 'Now or Never', when you are underground in the tunnels, you will come across a hidden library, which happens to be directly under the actual city library.
Thaler's monocle dialogue is now fixed in the next gen update. If you picked up the monocle in the quest 'A Frying Pan, Spick and Span', you can return it to Thaler in 'A Deadly Plot'.
The Passiflora innkeeper might be the only vendor that sells cucumbers and bananas.
The Passiflora has some rich female clients and several male workers.
This quest appears right after you escort Thaler back to his wagon in 'A Deadly Plot'.
This quest will only appear between 7am and 6pm.

In The Most Truest of Basilisks, once the fight begins, the Beast Tamer will take off running towards Novigrad Gate where he will cower in fear behind a small building. Geralt can follow him until he stops running, but will not be able to interact with him.

During Empty Coop, you can persuade the old lady to take in the children at the end of the quest. After a couple weeks in game, or after completing one or two quests, you can return to the hut and hear some dialogue between the old lady and the children.

name: Hey, You Wanna Look at My Stuff?

notes.text: There is a potential God of War reference, which is a man that somewhat looks similar to Kratos. It most likely is not a reference to Kratos since the character model is not as muscular, but he is bald, pale, and has red marks where the blades of chaos would be. It's on the beached ship directly north of the Novigrad Docks and South West of Electors' Square. The link will show you an image.
Purchase the lizard figurine from the merchant in Gildorf to begin the quest.

The lever at the top of Aeramas's residence simulates a 'light switch' that essentially turns off the sun for a few seconds. The mage was testing this and the lever has no other functional purpose for the quest.
In the quest, 'Of Dairy and Darkness', you will eventually receive The Emmentaler sword. What you may not have noticed, is that it can be dismantled into cheese.

specialNote.text: Very buggy: the quest may show red and restart automatically. Save before starting; finish it before restarting manually.

notes.text: This quest is a buggy quest. Red marks may appear during the quest that are resolved to green when you finish.
During Spooked Mare, bring the wrong horse to make the horse master happier and give you more coins.
The sword you get from 'Of Swords and Dumplings' now levels up with your character.
During 'Of Swords and Dumplings', if you sided with Iorveth in the Witcher 2, you will be able to persuade the dwarf to let you in without bribes or axii.

After finishing 'Of Swords and Dumplings' with Hattori, you can have a bit of follow-up in Skellige. If you go to Urialla Harbor, you can run into Sukrus, his brother in law, and the rival sword merchant they took from Novigrad. You can overhear them and it seems they intend to start a business again. You can't interact with them though.
If you want to be able to craft all of the possible decoctions, you must kill the doppler, since this is the only opportunity to get a doppler mutagen for the doppler decoction.
During Doors Slamming Shut, if you say you are from the School of the Griffin, you can haggle for more money.

During the contract: Doors Slamming Shut, Kurt Dysart (the quest giver) will die at a later time if the supports break when fighting the elemental. If they do not break, or only one breaks, Kurt will survive. If you break the pillars, when you return to the house, you will get an extra cutscene where you learn he actually died. Use the strategy @13:49 to fight the elemental in the corner to try and prevent the supports from breaking.
In the Cunny of the Goose brothel, there is a secret area behind a curtain @14:13 (you can't go into this area, but you can observe it from a window outside).
When doing the 'Lord of the Wood', after speaking with the Dwarf, when exiting the building, you will see a murder of crows leaving. The leshen has them as spies and will now know you are coming.
Talk to the widow from 'The White Lady' to prevent a red mark on that quest (the two quests are overlapping).
Crazy cat lady outside of Novigrad has a diary that can start the hunt for the feline armor. You can follow her around and she'll say odd things.

In 'Gwent: Big City Players', don't face Marquise Serenity until after you've met Dijkstra, otherwise the quest will complete without facing Dijkstra (though you can still face him and acquire his card). If you face her though, it shouldn't prevent you from finding all the Gwent cards, it just allows the Big City Players quest to continue without finishing too early.
You must win the tournament to get the missable cards and beat Tybalt to unlock the missable achievement Gwent Master.

name: The Mystery of the Byways Murders

notes.text: In 'Contract: The Mystery of the Byways Murders', you can get different amounts of pay depending on who you speak to first and what you say. To get the most coin, talk to the officer Milan first before going to Bywaters so that you can haggle for more gold. When at the village and after rescuing the two survivors, say 'I'm nosy' to Bytomir so that he doesn't know you were already hired to take care of the monster since he won't pay you if he knows you were hired. Once you kill the monster (after examining the soldiers' bodies, following the scent, and going into the tunnels under the hut), Bytomir will reward you with 210 coins. You can then return to Milan to collect the reward from him as well.

paths.option: Keira was spared and sent to Radovid
